cases.situation: I'm Nora Diaz and I run Slotwise, a scheduling tool for small clinics that cuts no-shows by about 30%. My old coworker Ben is friends with Laura Kim, the head of product at Canopy, whose clinic software would be a great integration partner. Ben and I are friendly but haven't talked in a year.
cases.reply:
Hi Ben,
Could I ask a favour? I'd love an intro to Laura Kim at Canopy. I'm building Slotwise, a scheduling tool for small clinics, and I think a Canopy integration could cut no-shows for their customers too. If you're not close enough for that to be comfortable, no worries at all, just say.
If you're up for it, here's a blurb you can forward:
"Laura, I'd like to introduce Nora Diaz. Nora runs Slotwise, which cuts no-shows for small clinics by about 30%, and she's interested in an integration with Canopy. She's asked for 20 minutes to compare notes; happy to connect you if you're open to it."
I'll let you know how it goes either way.
Nora
cases.note: The ask up front, a forwardable blurb, a real out and a promise to report back.

cases.situation: 我想申请星澜科技商业化团队的数据分析岗，我做了三年电商数据分析，主要用SQL和Python做用户分层。我大学学长在那边做产品，关系还行但不算特别熟，也没一起工作过，想问问他能不能内推。
cases.reply:
学长好，冒昧问一下：我在申请星澜科技商业化团队的数据分析岗，想问你方便帮我内推吗？我们没一起工作过，如果你觉得不太合适，完全理解，直接说就好，我不会介意的。
如果可以，我把岗位链接发你，下面这段可以直接贴进内推说明：“我做了三年电商数据分析，主要用SQL和Python做用户分层，想加入商业化团队的数据分析岗。”
不管结果怎样，我都会跟你说一声。
cases.note: 内推是对方拿名声担保，所以要明确给他说不的空间，并把他要做的事减到最少。

cases.situation: Ben introduced me to Laura at Canopy two weeks ago. We had a call last Tuesday and it went well, but there's no partnership yet: they're looking at partners again in Q1 and she asked me to check back in January. Should I tell Ben?
cases.reply: Quick update: Laura and I spoke last Tuesday and it was really useful. No integration yet, they're looking at partners again in Q1 and she's asked me to check back in January. Thank you for making it happen; I owe you a coffee.
cases.note: Report back even when it's not a win. Silence after their effort is what stops the next intro.

cases.situation: On 23 September I asked my former professor, Dr. Alvarez, if she'd introduce me to Kevin Tran, one of her old students who's now a hiring manager at a medical device company. I even wrote the blurb for her. No reply after eight days. Do I follow up?
cases.reply: Hi Dr. Alvarez, resurfacing my note of 23 September in case it got buried. It's completely fine to say no if you'd rather not make the intro to Kevin Tran, I'd just like to know whether to try another route. Either way, thank you for considering it.
cases.note: One nudge with the out restated, then find another path. A second chaser makes people avoid you.

cases.situation: I asked my friend Priya, who works at Larkfield Audio, to refer me for a product analyst role. She said she's not comfortable because we've never worked together and referrals are tracked against her. I'm a bit embarrassed, and we're still meant to get ramen on Thursday.
cases.reply: Totally fair, Priya, and thanks for being straight with me. I know your name's on the line with those. No awkwardness at all on my side, and I'm still up for that ramen on Thursday.
cases.note: A no on a referral is about her reputation, not your worth. Thank her, don't argue, and move the friendship straight back to normal.

cases.situation: I'm Maya Chen, raising a pre-seed round for Shiftwell, my scheduling app for home-care nurses, with 14 agencies on a paid pilot. I met a founder, Olu Adeyemi, once at a meetup in June and we've swapped a few LinkedIn messages since. He's close with Rachel Stein, an angel who backed two home-care startups, including Carely. Is it too much to ask him for an intro?
cases.reply:
Hi Olu,
Could I ask a favour? Please say no if it's too much, given we've only met once. I'm raising a pre-seed round for Shiftwell and I'd love an intro to Rachel Stein, since she backed Carely and knows home care well. The ask for her would be a 20-minute call in the next few weeks, nothing more.
If you're up for it, here's a blurb you can forward or edit:
"Rachel, I'd like to introduce Maya Chen. Maya runs Shiftwell, a scheduling and handover app for home-care nurses, with 14 agencies on a paid pilot. She's raising a pre-seed round and would value 20 minutes of your view on the space. Happy to connect you if you're open to it."
Either way, I'll let you know how the raise goes. Thanks, Olu.
Maya
cases.note: A weak tie asking for an investor intro: the out comes first and the blurb carries one real traction number, so his reputation risk stays small.

cases.situation: I'm Daniel, newly self-employed as a sound engineer with simple books. My friend Priya's accountant, Helen Ward, isn't taking new clients, but Priya says she sometimes makes room for referrals. I want to ask Priya to pass on a note asking Helen for a 15-minute call.
cases.reply:
Hi Priya,
Could I ask a favour? Would you be comfortable passing a note to Helen Ward for me? I've just gone self-employed and my books are simple, so I'd be an easy client, and you mentioned she sometimes makes room for referrals. If it would use up goodwill you'd rather keep for yourself, no problem at all, just say.
If you're happy to, here's something you can forward:
"Helen, my friend Daniel has just gone self-employed as a sound engineer and his books are simple. He knows you're not taking new clients, so he'd just value a 15-minute call to see whether you might have room. No pressure either way."
I'll let you know how it goes either way.
Daniel
cases.note: Asking a friend to spend her standing with her own provider: the out names that cost, and the blurb lets Helen say no easily.

cases.situation: 我叫林悦，在市场部做了三年用户增长，今年牵头的会员拉新活动转化率比去年高40%，手上还有双十一项目。想转到产品部，领导周姐人很好，跟产品部的何总很熟，想请她帮我引荐聊半小时，但怕她觉得我是嫌弃现在的工作。
cases.reply:
周姐，想请您帮个忙：能不能帮我引荐一下产品部的何总？我以后想往产品方向发展，想先跟何总聊30分钟，了解他们团队需要什么样的人。手上的双十一项目我会负责到底，这个不会变。您要是觉得现在不合适，直接跟我说就好。
如果方便，下面这段可以直接转给何总：
“何总，介绍一下我们组的林悦。她做了三年用户增长，今年的会员拉新活动是她牵头的，转化率比去年高了40%。她对产品方向很感兴趣，想约您30分钟聊聊，您看方便吗？”
不管结果怎样，聊完我都跟您说一声。
cases.note: 请现任领导引荐内部转岗：先说清手上的工作不受影响，给她说不的空间，附一段能直接转发的介绍。

cases.situation: Three weeks ago my friend Hannah introduced me by email to Tom Reyes, a director at a solar company, for a chat about switching into the industry. I emailed Tom on Sept 9 and again last week, no reply. Meanwhile I've lined up a call with someone at SunPeak on Monday. Hannah just texted 'did you two ever talk?'
cases.reply: Not yet! I emailed Tom on the 9th and again last week, no reply so far, which is totally fine, so I'll leave it there rather than chase him. Thank you again for the intro. It got me thinking about who else to talk to, and I've got a call with someone at SunPeak on Monday. I'll let you know how it goes.
cases.note: Report back even when the intro went nowhere: no complaint about Tom, no asking her to nudge him, and a next step so her effort feels worth it.

cases.situation: 我叫小林，是做小程序的自由开发者，刚给一家烘焙店做完点单小程序，上线一个月线上订单占了三成，老板娘王姐很满意。听说她跟隔壁街豆子咖啡的周老板很熟，周老板最近在找人做会员系统。想请王姐帮我引荐。
cases.reply:
王姐，想请您帮个忙：听说您跟豆子咖啡的周老板挺熟，他最近在找人做会员小程序，方便帮我引荐一下吗？如果不好开口，完全没关系，直接跟我说就行。

要是方便，这段可以直接转给他：'周老板，介绍一下小林，我们店的点单小程序就是他做的，上线一个月线上订单占了三成，做事很靠谱。他想跟你聊20分钟，看看会员系统怎么做合适。'

不管结果怎样，我都会跟您说一声。谢谢王姐！
cases.note: 向满意的客户要引荐：开头就说请求，附一段带真实数字、可直接转发的介绍，给她说不的余地，并承诺回报结果。

cases.situation: I'm Jordan Lee, applying for PhDs in marine ecology this winter; my undergrad thesis with Dr. Chen was on urchin grazing in kelp beds. Chen did her postdoc with Prof. Adaeze Okafor, whose kelp forest recovery lab at Dalhousie is my first choice. I'd like Chen to introduce me so I can ask whether she's taking students for fall 2027 before I apply.
cases.reply:
Hi Dr. Chen,
Could I ask a favour? I'd love an intro to Prof. Okafor at Dalhousie. Her lab's work on kelp forest recovery is the closest match to my thesis, and I'd like to ask whether she's taking PhD students for fall 2027 before I apply. If it's not a good moment to reach out to her, no problem at all, just say.
If you're up for it, here's a blurb you can forward:
"Adaeze, I'd like to introduce Jordan Lee, who did an honours thesis with me on urchin grazing in kelp beds. Jordan is applying for PhDs this winter and would value a 15-minute call, or a short email, about whether your lab is taking students next year."
I'll let you know how it goes either way.
Jordan
cases.note: Academic intros follow the same shape: one small, specific ask of the professor, a blurb in the advisor's voice, and a real out.

cases.situation: 我叫林晓，做设计，11月从杭州调到成都工作，在那边一个人都不认识。大学室友小雅有个朋友阿楠在成都住了五年，也喜欢爬山。想请小雅介绍我们认识，主要想问问租房和生活。
cases.reply:
小雅，想请你帮个忙：我11月要调到成都了，那边一个人都不认识，能不能把我介绍给阿楠？我主要想请她吃顿饭，问问住哪个区方便，别的不多打扰。你们要是最近联系不多、不好开口，直接说就行，我自己慢慢摸索。

方便的话，这段可以直接转给她：“阿楠，介绍一下我大学室友林晓，11月从杭州调到成都做设计。她想找个本地人问问租房和生活，顺便认识个爬山搭子，想请你吃顿饭。你愿意的话我拉个群。”

见完一定跟你汇报！
cases.note: 不是为工作的引荐也一样：说清要对方花多少时间，附一段能直接转发的介绍，给一个真的退路。

cases.situation: I'm Priya, a freelance illustrator. Ruth, an art director at Brightwater Books and my biggest current client, mentioned that her former colleague Sofia Marsh now runs a picture-book imprint. I'd like an intro for a 15-minute call to show Sofia my portfolio, but I don't want Ruth to feel obliged because she pays me.
cases.reply:
Hi Ruth, could I ask a favour, with no pressure at all? I'd love an intro to Sofia Marsh, for a 15-minute call to show her my portfolio in case it's a fit for her imprint. This is completely separate from our work together, and if it doesn't feel right for any reason, just say and nothing changes on my side.

If you're up for it, here's a blurb you can forward:
"Sofia, I'd like to introduce Priya, a freelance illustrator I work with regularly. She'd love 15 minutes to show you her portfolio, in case it's a fit for your list. Happy to connect you if you're open to it."

I'll let you know how it goes either way. Thanks, Priya
cases.note: Asking a paying client for an intro: keep it apart from the work you do for her and make the out explicit, so it never feels like part of the deal.

cases.situation: My nephew Aarav Mehta graduated in civil engineering in May; his senior project was a load study on a pedestrian bridge, and he's deciding between structural consultancies and the state DOT. My old college friend Dana Whitfield is a senior engineer at a bridge consultancy in Denver; we haven't talked in about two years. I want to ask if she'd talk to Aarav, not give him a job.
cases.reply:
Hi Dana, could I ask a small favour? My nephew Aarav has just graduated in civil engineering and wants to go into bridge design, and I'd love for him to have 20 minutes with you about how you got into the field. He isn't asking for a job, just a real picture of the work before he applies anywhere. If the timing's bad, no problem at all. If you're up for it, here's a note from him, and you can reply to him directly:

"Hi Dana, I'm Aarav Mehta, a May civil engineering graduate. My senior project was a load study on a pedestrian bridge, and I'm deciding between structural consultancies and the state DOT. Would you have 20 minutes for a call in the next few weeks? I'm happy to work around your schedule."

I'll let you know how he gets on. Thanks either way.
cases.note: Asking on someone else's behalf: keep the ask small, let them speak for themselves in the blurb, and you still owe the report back.

cases.situation: Ich bin Katrin Weber und suche eine technische Mitgründerin für Hofkiste, meine App, über die Hofläden Vorbestellungen annehmen; 23 Höfe im Raum Freiburg nutzen sie schon. Mein früherer Kollege Jonas hat erzählt, dass seine Freundin Lena Vogel, Backend-Entwicklerin, gerade gekündigt hat und etwas Eigenes sucht. Jonas und ich schreiben uns nur ab und zu auf WhatsApp.
cases.reply:
Hi Jonas, darf ich dich um einen Gefallen bitten? Ich würde mich über eine Vorstellung bei Lena Vogel freuen. Ich suche für Hofkiste eine technische Mitgründerin, und nach dem, was du erzählt hast, könnte ein Gespräch für beide spannend sein. Wenn es sich für dich komisch anfühlt, ist das völlig in Ordnung, sag einfach Bescheid.

Falls du magst, hier ein Text zum Weiterleiten:
„Lena, ich möchte dir Katrin Weber vorstellen. Katrin baut Hofkiste, eine App, über die Hofläden Vorbestellungen annehmen; 23 Höfe im Raum Freiburg nutzen sie schon. Sie sucht eine technische Mitgründerin und würde sich gern 30 Minuten unverbindlich mit dir austauschen. Soll ich euch verbinden?“

Ich sage dir so oder so Bescheid, wie es gelaufen ist. Danke dir!
Katrin
cases.note: Co-founder intro: the ask stays small (30 minutes, no commitment) so Jonas only vouches for a conversation, not a partnership.

cases.situation: I'm Leah Porter and I run a small nonprofit, Second Shift, that repairs donated laptops for school kids; we've given out 1,200 so far. My cousin Hannah used to work with Mark Ellis, the education reporter at our city paper. I'd like her to introduce me so I can tell him about our open day on Nov 14.
cases.reply:
Hi Hannah, could I ask a favour? I'd love an intro to Mark Ellis. Second Shift has now given 1,200 repaired laptops to school kids, and our open day on 14 November could be a good local education story for him. If you're not in touch enough for that to feel comfortable, just say, no problem at all.
If you're up for it, here's a blurb you can forward:
"Mark, I'd like to introduce my cousin Leah Porter. Leah runs Second Shift, a nonprofit that repairs donated laptops for school kids, 1,200 so far. She has an open day on 14 November and would value 10 minutes to tell you about it, in case it's useful for a story."
I'll let you know how it goes either way. Thanks!
Leah
cases.note: A press intro: the blurb gives the reporter a story hook and asks for 10 minutes, never for coverage.

cases.situation: 我是独立纪录片导演，在拍一部关于传统手艺人的片子。好朋友阿杰的舅舅认识景德镇一位做了四十年拉坯的陈师傅，我想请阿杰帮忙问问，11月去陈师傅作坊拍三天，按天付他误工费，成片先给他看，他不想用的镜头就删。
cases.reply: 阿杰，想请你帮个忙：能不能请你舅舅帮我问问陈师傅，愿不愿意让我11月去他作坊拍三天？下面这段你可以直接转给舅舅：“您好，我是阿杰的朋友，独立纪录片导演，正在拍一部关于传统手艺人的片子，想记录陈师傅拉坯的过程。计划11月在作坊拍三天，按天付误工费，成片先请陈师傅过目，他不想用的镜头都删掉。”要是舅舅跟陈师傅不算太熟，或者不方便开这个口，直接跟我说就行，完全没关系。有结果了我一定告诉你。
cases.note: 给拍摄对象的好处（误工费、成片审看权）写进可转发的那段，舅舅开口时就不用替你担保。

cases.situation: 私は彩。大学からの友人の美咲の同僚、高橋さんに先月美咲の誕生日会で会って、二人とも山登りが好きだと分かって話が盛り上がった。高橋さんは今フリーらしい。美咲に紹介を頼みたいけど、職場の人だから気まずくさせたくない。
cases.reply: 美咲、ちょっとお願いがあるんだけど、高橋さんを紹介してもらえないかな？誕生日会で山の話をしたのがすごく楽しくて、もう少しゆっくり話してみたいなと思って。職場の人だし、気まずくなりそうなら全然断ってくれて大丈夫だよ。もしよければ、こんな感じで伝えてもらえたら嬉しい：「誕生日会で山の話をした友だちの彩が、また話したいって。今度3人でお茶でもどう？」どうなっても、ちゃんと報告するね。
cases.note: 恋愛の紹介でも形は同じ：職場の関係を気にする友人に断る余地を渡し、3人で会う軽い形にして、そのまま伝えられる一文を添える。

cases.situation: I asked my former colleague Rita to introduce me to Sam Okoro, a product director at a health-tech company, for a 20-minute chat about moving into product. Rita replied that she's only met Sam twice at conferences and doesn't feel she can make a formal intro, but I'm welcome to email him and mention her name.
cases.reply: That's really helpful, Rita, thank you, and completely fair. I'll email Sam myself and just say you suggested I get in touch, nothing more, so it doesn't put anything on you. I'll let you know how it goes either way.
cases.note: When they offer their name instead of an intro, accept it gladly, say exactly how you'll use it, and still report back.

cases.situation: I play keys in a jazz trio, the Low Tide Trio. My old bandmate Marcus plays The Blue Heron most months and knows the booker, Tanya. We want a Thursday night slot in November; we've played 30 gigs at smaller bars this year, usually pull 40 to 50 people, and have a live recording. Marcus and I text now and then.
cases.reply:
Hey Marcus, could I ask a favour? Would you be up for introducing us to Tanya at The Blue Heron? We're after a Thursday night slot in November, and since we usually pull 40 to 50 people I think we'd be a decent bet for a weeknight.

If it helps, here's something you can forward: "The Low Tide Trio is a piano, bass and drums jazz trio that's played 30 gigs around town this year. They'd love a Thursday in November and can send a live recording first."

If you'd rather not put your name on it with Tanya, totally fine, just say. Either way I'll let you know how it goes.
cases.note: Peer-to-peer in a small scene: the blurb gives the booker a number she cares about, and the out protects Marcus's own gigs there.

cases.situation: My friend Nadia just emailed an intro to me and Grace Liu, a UX research lead, saying I'm moving into UX research after eight years teaching secondary science and would love 20 minutes of Grace's time. Grace hasn't replied yet. What do I write back?
cases.reply: Thanks so much, Nadia (moving you to bcc). Grace, lovely to meet you. After eight years teaching secondary science I'm moving into UX research, and I'd really value 20 minutes to hear how you'd approach that switch. Would a video call in the next couple of weeks work? I'm happy to fit around your schedule, and no worries at all if now's a busy time.
cases.note: Reply fast, move the introducer to bcc so she sees it landed, keep the ask small, and report back to Nadia after the call.

cases.situation: I'm Leo and I make a hot sauce, Ember & Ash, selling about 200 bottles a month at local markets. I want to move to 500-bottle batches, and my friend Owen's aunt, Carol, runs a shared commercial kitchen that does small-batch bottling. I'd like a 20-minute call with her about pricing and minimum runs; Owen and I play five-a-side every week.
cases.reply:
Hi Owen, could I ask a favour? Would you be up for introducing me to your aunt Carol? I'm looking to move Ember & Ash up to 500-bottle batches, and her kitchen sounds like exactly the right kind of place. If it feels awkward asking family, just say, no problem at all.

If you're happy to, here's something you can forward: "Carol, my friend Leo makes Ember & Ash hot sauce and sells about 200 bottles a month at local markets. He's looking to move to 500-bottle batches and would love a 20-minute call about your pricing and minimum runs. Happy to put you in touch if you're open to it."

I'll let you know how it goes either way. Cheers, Leo
cases.note: The out matters more with family: asking a relative for a favour costs Owen more than asking a colleague.

cases.situation: 我叫林晓，在杭州办了一个公益读书会，每月一次，大概40人参加。想请作家沈岚11月来做一次一小时左右的分享，没有讲课费，但读书会承担往返高铁票和一晚住宿，时间按她方便来定。我的朋友小周是她新书的责任编辑。
cases.reply:
小周，想请你帮个忙：能不能帮我问问沈岚老师，愿不愿意11月来我们读书会做一次分享？如果你觉得不方便开口，或者她最近太忙，直接说就好，完全没关系。
方便的话，下面这段可以直接转给她：“沈老师，介绍一下我朋友林晓，她在杭州办了一个公益读书会，每月一次，大概40人参加。她想请您11月来做一次一小时左右的分享，没有讲课费，往返高铁票和一晚住宿由读书会承担，时间按您方便来定。”
不管结果怎样，我都会跟你说一声。
cases.note: 请人引荐去做无偿的事：在可转发的那段里写明没有讲课费和能提供什么，编辑朋友开口时就不用替你打圆场。

cases.situation: Soy Inés y me mudo a Madrid en noviembre por trabajo. Mi amiga Carmen me contó que su tío Andrés alquila un estudio en Lavapiés que queda libre el 1 de noviembre. Quiero pedirle a Carmen que me presente: puedo pagar hasta 850 € al mes, tengo contrato indefinido y puedo enseñar mis últimas nóminas.
cases.reply:
Carmen, ¿te puedo pedir un favor? ¿Me presentarías a tu tío Andrés por lo del estudio de Lavapiés que queda libre el 1 de noviembre? Si te resulta incómodo meterte en temas de alquiler con la familia, dímelo sin problema, lo entiendo perfectamente.
Si te parece bien, aquí tienes un mensaje para reenviarle:
«Andrés, te presento a mi amiga Inés. Se muda a Madrid en noviembre por trabajo, tiene contrato indefinido y puede enseñarte sus últimas nóminas. Busca un estudio de hasta 850 € al mes y le encantaría ver el tuyo. ¿Te paso su número?»
Te cuento cómo va, salga o no. ¡Gracias!
Inés
cases.note: Presentación a un casero conocido: el texto reenviable lleva lo que a él le importa (solvencia y fechas), y la salida protege la relación familiar de Carmen.

cases.situation: 我叫陈悦，我爸68岁，医生建议他做膝关节置换，我们想手术前再听一次第二意见。好友小何的大学同学孙医生在一家三甲医院骨科看关节。想请小何问问能不能正常挂孙医生的号看一次，我们按流程挂号付费，不想让她私下看片子。
cases.reply:
小何，想请你帮个忙：能不能帮我问问你同学孙医生，我爸能不能正常挂她的号看一次膝关节？医生建议他做置换，我们想手术前再听一次第二意见，按流程挂号付费，不用她私下看片子。要是你们不常联系，或者问这种事让你为难，直接跟我说就行，完全没关系。

方便的话，这段可以直接转给她：“孙医生，我朋友陈悦的父亲68岁，医生建议做膝关节置换，家里想在手术前听一次第二意见。他们想正常挂您的号看一次，不知道您门诊方便吗？”

不管能不能约上，我都跟你说一声。谢谢！
cases.note: 为家人请朋友引荐医生：把请求限定在正常挂号，不让朋友替你去要私下的人情，退路也要说得明确。

cases.situation: 我叫小敏，女儿一岁半，明年3月起想请个白天带娃的育儿嫂，周一到周五早8点到晚6点，月薪6500元。同楼的刘姐家请的张阿姨口碑特别好，刘姐说她家孩子明年2月上幼儿园，张阿姨就不用再去她家了。想请刘姐帮我问问张阿姨，但又怕刘姐觉得我在抢她的阿姨。
cases.reply:
刘姐，想请您帮个忙：听您说明年2月孩子上幼儿园后，张阿姨就不去您家了，方便帮我问问她愿不愿意3月起来我家吗？您家那边肯定优先，要是您还想留张阿姨，或者觉得不好开口，直接跟我说就行，完全没关系。
方便的话，这段可以直接转给张阿姨：“张阿姨，楼上的小敏想请您明年3月起白天帮她带一岁半的女儿，周一到周五早8点到晚6点，月薪6500元。您有兴趣的话，她想约您见面聊聊。”
不管成不成，我都跟您说一声。谢谢刘姐！
cases.note: 引荐别人家正在用的阿姨：先把对方家的安排放在前面，给一个真退路，转发的那段写清时间和工资，免得刘姐替你谈条件。

cases.situation: I'm Grace Okafor and I've finished my first novel, The Salt Year, an 85,000-word literary novel; two of my short stories have appeared in literary magazines. My friend Tom, a published novelist, is represented by the agent Helen Brandt, who takes on literary fiction. Tom hasn't read the manuscript, and I don't want him to feel he has to vouch for a book he hasn't read.
cases.reply:
Hi Tom, could I ask a favour, with a genuine no-pressure clause? I've finished The Salt Year and I'd love to send it to Helen Brandt. You haven't read it, so I'm not asking you to vouch for it, only whether you'd be comfortable letting her know a query is coming from a friend of yours. If that's more than you want to put your name to, just say, and I'll query her the usual way.

If you're up for it, here's something you could forward:
"Helen, a friend of mine, Grace Okafor, has finished her first novel, The Salt Year, an 85,000-word literary novel, and two of her short stories have appeared in literary magazines. I haven't read the manuscript, but she'd like to send you a query if you're open to it."

I'll let you know how it goes either way. Thanks, Tom.
Grace
cases.note: When your contact can't judge the work, ask only for a heads-up, never an endorsement, and say so in the blurb.

cases.situation: I'm Ravi Shah. I finished a coding bootcamp in June and my capstone was a matchmaking service for a two-player puzzle game. I want an intro to Melissa Grant, an engineering manager at Tidepool Games, for 15 minutes about their junior backend role, and I'm thinking of posting in our bootcamp alumni Slack's referrals channel since I don't know who knows her.
cases.reply:
Hi all, one specific ask: does anyone here know Melissa Grant, engineering manager at Tidepool Games, well enough to introduce me? I'm applying for their junior backend role and would value 15 minutes with her about what the team looks for. Only if you actually know her, please don't stretch a loose connection on my behalf.
If you can, here's a blurb you can forward:
"Melissa, I'd like to introduce Ravi Shah, who finished our bootcamp in June. His capstone was a matchmaking service for a two-player puzzle game, and he's applying for your junior backend role. He'd value 15 minutes on what the team looks for, if you're open to it."
I'll post an update here either way. Thanks!
Ravi
cases.note: Asking a group: name one person and one small ask, and make the out explicit so nobody vouches for someone they barely know.

cases.situation: I'm Amara Okeke, a pharmacist with eight years' experience in Lagos, and I moved to Toronto in July. My neighbour Joyce mentioned that her sister, Ruth Mensah, trained as a pharmacist abroad and got licensed here three years ago. I'd like Joyce to ask Ruth for a 20-minute call about the licensing exams and how she found her first job.
cases.reply:
Hi Joyce, could I ask a favour? Would you be comfortable asking your sister Ruth whether she'd have 20 minutes for a call with me about the pharmacy licensing exams and how she found her first job here? If it's not a good time for her, or you'd rather not ask, that's completely fine.

If it helps, here's a note you could send her:

"Ruth, my neighbour Amara Okeke is a pharmacist with eight years' experience in Lagos who moved to Toronto in July. She's starting the licensing process and would love 20 minutes on the phone to hear how you did it. Happy to pass on her number if you're open to it."

I'll let you know how it goes either way. Thank you!
Amara
cases.note: A neighbour rather than a work contact: the blurb keeps it a small, specific ask, and Ruth says yes before any number is shared.

cases.situation: I'm Karen Liu. I was laid off from Ashgrove in August after 12 years running QA. Marcus reported to me there for four years and is now a team lead at Fernway, which has a senior QA manager opening. I'd like him to refer me, but I don't want him to feel he owes me because I used to be his boss.
cases.reply:
Hi Marcus, I'll be direct: I'm applying for the senior QA manager role at Fernway, and I wondered if you'd be comfortable referring me. Please don't feel any obligation because I used to be your manager; if it's awkward for any reason, a simple no is completely fine and changes nothing between us. If you're up for it, here's a line you can paste: "Karen Liu ran QA at Ashgrove for 12 years and managed me for four. She's applying for the senior QA manager role." I'll let you know how it goes either way.
Karen
cases.note: Asking someone you used to manage: take the old hierarchy off the table explicitly, because the power gap makes no harder to say.

cases.situation: Sou o Lucas Almeida, fotógrafo de casamentos em Porto Alegre há seis anos. Minha prima Fernanda topou me apresentar à Juliana Costa, dona do espaço de eventos Quinta das Videiras, e pediu um e-mail curto que ela possa só encaminhar. Quero pedir 20 minutos para mostrar meu portfólio e saber se posso entrar na lista de fornecedores indicados.
cases.reply:
Fernanda, muito obrigado por topar! Aqui vai o texto para você só encaminhar, pode mexer no que quiser:

"Juliana, quero te apresentar o Lucas Almeida, meu primo, que fotografa casamentos em Porto Alegre há seis anos. Ele adoraria 20 minutos com você para mostrar o portfólio e saber se faz sentido entrar na lista de fornecedores indicados da Quinta das Videiras. Se você topar, eu passo o contato dele."

Se depois de ler você preferir não mandar, tudo certo, sem problema nenhum. Te conto como foi, de qualquer jeito.
Lucas
cases.note: Quando a pessoa já disse sim, o trabalho é entregar o texto pronto para encaminhar, com um pedido pequeno, uma saída e a promessa de dar retorno.

cases.situation: I'm Sara Klein and I run Crumbwell Bakeries, four bakeries with 30 staff. I'm hiring an operations manager, £48,000, hybrid. My friend Alice mentioned that her former colleague Dev Patel ran operations for a coffee chain and might be open to a move; I'd like Alice to ask Dev whether he'd be up for a 20-minute chat with no commitment.
cases.reply:
Hi Alice, could I ask a favour? You mentioned Dev Patel ran operations for a coffee chain and might be open to a move. Would you be comfortable asking him if he'd like a 20-minute chat about the operations manager role at Crumbwell? No commitment on his side, and if you'd rather not, or you think he isn't looking, just say.
If you're up for it, here's a blurb you can forward:
"Dev, my friend Sara Klein runs Crumbwell Bakeries, four bakeries with 30 staff, and she's hiring an operations manager, £48,000, hybrid. She'd love a 20-minute chat, no commitment, if you're curious. Shall I pass on your email?"
I'll let you know how it goes either way.
Sara
cases.note: When you're the one hiring, the blurb leads with the salary and setup so Dev can say no before anyone's time is spent.

cases.situation: I'm Hannah Moss. I was a payroll manager for nine years, then took three years out to care for my dad. My old friend Leila works in finance at Calder Homes, which runs a 12-week paid returnship for people coming back after a career break; applications close on Friday 23 October. We still text, but we've never worked together.
cases.reply:
Hi Leila, could I ask a favour? I'm applying for the returnship at Calder Homes, and I wondered if you'd be comfortable referring me. We've never worked together, so if you'd rather not put your name to it, just say, and it changes nothing between us. If you're up for it, here's a line you can paste: "Hannah Moss was a payroll manager for nine years, then took three years out as a carer. She's applying for the 12-week returnship." Applications close on Friday 23 October, and I'll let you know how it goes either way.
Hannah
cases.note: Coming back from a career break: name the gap plainly in the blurb so your friend never has to explain it, and keep the out real.

cases.situation: I'm Tomás Rivera, a data engineer. My former manager Beth knows Ifeoma Bello, who organises the DataHarbor Summit in March. The call for speakers has closed, but Beth says Ifeoma sometimes adds lightning talks; mine would be a 5-minute talk on how we cut our cloud bill by 38% by switching off idle test environments. I'd like Beth to ask whether Ifeoma would read a one-paragraph proposal.
cases.reply:
Hi Beth,
Could I ask a favour? Would you be comfortable introducing me to Ifeoma Bello? I know the DataHarbor call for speakers has closed, so the only ask is whether she'd read a one-paragraph proposal for a lightning talk. If it feels like pushing her past her own deadline, no problem at all, just say.
If you're up for it, here's a blurb you can forward:
"Ifeoma, I'd like to introduce Tomás Rivera, a data engineer I used to manage. He has a 5-minute talk on how his team cut their cloud bill by 38% by switching off idle test environments. He knows the call has closed and would just like to send you a one-paragraph proposal in case you add lightning talks."
I'll let you know how it goes either way.
Tomás
cases.note: When a deadline has passed, shrink the ask to reading one paragraph, so your contact isn't asking for an exception on your behalf.

cases.situation: 我叫苏晴，28岁，上个月确诊了1型糖尿病，还在适应每天打胰岛素。闺蜜小雨说她表姐阿珍也是1型，已经二十年了，还跑过半马。想请小雨介绍我们加个微信，聊二十分钟平时怎么安排饮食和运动，不是请她给医疗建议。
cases.reply:
小雨，想请你帮个忙：能不能把我介绍给你表姐阿珍？我上个月确诊了1型糖尿病，还在适应，特别想跟一个过来人聊二十分钟，听听她平时怎么安排饮食和运动，不是要她给医疗建议。病情是很私人的事，她要是不想聊，或者你觉得不好开口，直接说就行，完全没关系。
方便的话，这段可以直接转给她：“表姐，我闺蜜苏晴上个月确诊了1型糖尿病，28岁，还在适应打胰岛素。她听说你是过来人，还跑过半马，想加你微信聊二十分钟，问问日常饮食和运动是怎么安排的。你愿意的话我把她微信推给你。”
不管成不成，我都跟你说一声。
cases.note: 请人引荐病友：退路要照顾到对方可能不想谈自己的病；用药和剂量仍以自己的医生为准。
